messages:
Ava (CEO): thanks everyone for joining the all-hands — quick follow-up thread for the security panel. drop any questions about SOC2/ISO timelines, VPC/private deployment, KMS/BYOK, and audit logs here and we'll answer live/after.
Mae (SRE): is BYOK supported for Redwood Private today? also curious how key rotation works in Dedicated vs hosted.
Samir (Head of Security): short answer: yes for Private and Dedicated. we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, and HSMs (PKCS#11). hosted customers get managed keys by default; we offer BYOK for enterprise plans. rotation depends on deployment: for BYOK you control rotation; for managed keys we rotate per our policy (90 days recommended) and can enable automatic key-rolling.
Tomas (Infra): technical note: rotation is implemented as key-wrapping + re-encryption of key material. workflow we use: create new KMS key -> generate new data key -> rewrap master key -> swap pointers. this is online; typical rollover window < 2 minutes for connection handoffs.
Mae (SRE): can we request an option for forced rotation window <30 days for high-security customers?
Samir (Head of Security): yes we can support custom rotation SLAs on Dedicated/Private. for hosted we'll need an enterprise commit. we'll add configurable rotation policies to the roadmap.
Lena (Compliance): audit logs question: what's default retention, and can customers stream raw audit logs to their SIEM (Splunk/Datadog/S3)?
Jordan (VP Product): roadmap: SOC2 Type II goal still on track for Q3; ISO 27001 targeting Q4 and will be coordinated with sales for compliance packs.
Samir (Head of Security): audit log details: hosted default retention=90 days, with WORM style append-only storage. Dedicated/Private customers can set retention and export. streaming supported via S3, Kinesis, Syslog. logs are structured JSON with event_type, actor, resource_id, request_id. sensitive fields are redacted by default.
Mae (SRE): can you paste an example syslog URI?
Samir (Head of Security): example syslog endpoint: ```syslog://logs.example.com:514?format=json&project=acme```
Lena (Compliance): who can view full plaintext logs in emergencies? we need audited access controls for regulators.
Samir (Head of Security): only users with explicit "investigate:read_logs" privilege in IAM can request full access; requests are logged and require a 2nd approver from security. default behavior is redact PII (email, full prompt tokens). escalation process documented in Confluence: https://redwood.example.com/docs/security/audit-logs
Mae (SRE): quick question: for hosted customers who want BYOK for specific routes (e.g., embeddings only) — is that doable?
Samir (Head of Security): partially — we support key scoping at the deployment level currently. per-route key scoping is on the backlog; we'll accept product tickets for prioritized customers.
Jordan (VP Product): action items: we'll add per-route BYOK to the roadmap as "security-req-47" and surface cost/ops tradeoffs.
security-bot: NOTE: SOC2 checklist updated by Samir — https://redwood.example.com/security/soc2-checklist (automated) :white_check_mark:
Tomas (Infra): CLI sample to attach a KMS key (internal example): ```redwood config kms attach --provider aws --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abc --rotation true```
Mae (SRE): thanks — any ETA on docs for rotation and export configs?
Samir (Head of Security): we'll publish an RFC and step-by-step guides today in #eng-security and post the docs link here by EOD. if anyone needs a zoom to walk through migration plan, ping me.
Ava (CEO): huge thanks — looks like concrete follow-ups. please keep customer-impacting tickets flagged for Sales/AE.
Lena (Compliance): will follow up with legal on ISO evidence collection process.
Samir (Head of Security): final note: for private/on-prem customers we can integrate with HSMs and provide attestation reports on request — reach out for specific integrations.
Mae (SRE): noted. posting an internal ticket to track BYOK per-route.
Ava (CEO): closing thread — great discussion. :rocket:
